diffs.diff: minimum supply: part 4.5 V, datasheet reading 5 V
diffs.evidence: M5Stack only states the nominal 5 V port supply (PinMap GND/5V/SDA/SCL), and the unit has no regulator, so the real limit is the ATmega328 on VCC, whose Microchip datasheet gives the full-speed operating band as '0 - 20MHz @ 4.5 - 5.5V'; 4.5 V is therefore the correct minimum around the 5 V nominal, not a different value.

diffs.diff: maximum supply: part 5.5 V, datasheet reading 5 V
diffs.evidence: The second reading copied the M5Stack nominal 5 V port value; the unit feeds 5 V straight to the ATmega328 (no regulator), whose Microchip datasheet caps operation at 5.5 V ('0 - 20MHz @ 4.5 - 5.5V'), so 5.5 V is the correct maximum.
